Beth —

Appreciate the clarity. Draft MAP attached (CardioTech_MAP_v1.pdf). High-level summary inline below; we can adjust after legal/cloud feedback.

Short summary:
- Hosted API: fastest time-to-value (1–2 weeks), lowest engineering overhead, supports US regions; standard shared KMS but can integrate with customer-supplied keys for tokens. Good for pilot where latency tolerance ~150–200ms.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools (4–8 GPUs initially), predictable throughput and lower per-token cost at scale, SLA-backed latencies (~100–150ms). Data isolation in dedicated tenant, can use customer-managed KMS in VPC peering flow.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full data sovereignty and HSM/KMS integration, longer lead time (6–10 weeks), requires customer infra and network config. Lowest regulatory risk for PHI.

Suggested pilot timeline:
- Week 0–1: MAP sign-off + SOW
- Week 2–3: Provisioning (hosted or dedicated dev setup)
- Week 4–7: Pilot run + metrics collection
- Week 8: Decision review & procurement

Attached: CardioTech_MAP_v1.pdf, preliminary pricing sheet.

Next steps: I'll loop Karthik for pricing details and Jonas for rollout runbook. If legal wants SOC2 artifacts, I'll attach a redacted evidence bundle.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
